events.title: beabadoobee: The Powerlines Tour in Seoul
events.summary: beabadoobee brings The Powerlines Tour to Olympic Hall in Seoul on March 23, 2027. The NOL World listing confirms the date, venue, ticket categories, and 12+ age rating.

events.title: Rockin' Sensation vol.15 - 20th Anniversary
events.summary: A 20th-anniversary edition of Rockin' Sensation, a Seoul breaking event rooted in the city’s hip-hop dance scene and running since 2007; the source lists it as a save-the-date for March 27, 2027.
